_note: The mage's left-click per element (src/vfx/mage_bolt.gd, wired in hell_game._attack). His element: the leading talent spec (hero_skins.json spec_elements: fire -> fire, frost -> ice, arcane -> void); none before any talent. kind: the shot kind (pyro: the small fireball that bursts where it strikes, user wish 30.10.2026; magic: the plain arcane bolt in the crypt look; icicle and void_orb are drawn and burst by mage_bolt.gd). speed_mult on the weapon's shot speed; splash_mult on the weapon's splash (0: a single-target bolt; the icicle brings its slow, the orb its pull instead). slow, slow_time: share and seconds the icicle's chill slows what it strikes. pull: world px/s the orb draws small enemies in by, fading to 0 at pull_radius (never bosses). len (icicle) and r (orb) in 3 px grid cells. splinters, patch_r, patch_n: the icicle's shards and its frost patch; implode_n, implode_r, traces: the orb's matter rushing in and the traces it leaves. cast_sfx, hit_sfx, wall_sfx: audio_sfx.json events. colors lit to shade (hex); glow [colour, alpha] on the world's glow layer.
